text:
emily_marketing: FYI — quick follow-up from today's benchmark publish: Guardian piece is quoting a latency stat we never released. Can someone check whether that came from our press kit or a misquote?

nate_pr: I see it. Pulling the clip now. Looks like they're referencing a slide that wasn't in public assets (pre-quantization numbers). I'll reach out to the reporter for a correction. Please pause any automated syndication.

pressops_bot: Automated alert: external pickup detected for article URL. Auto-promotion paused. Recommend manual hold on all amplification channels.

anita_legal: If it's a factual error, request a correction with minimal technical detail. Suggested line: "The number referenced was from an internal pre-validation run and does not reflect our final published results." Legal available to review final wording.

carmen_ceo: If quick correction possible, good. Nate, draft a short statement and loop me in for approval if it's substantive. We should avoid deep technical rebuttals publicly.

social_ops: We've paused the promo queue and flagged partner syndication. Waiting for official guidance before re-enabling.

nate_pr: Draft reply to reporter: "Thanks for covering our work. That figure appears to reference an internal pre-validation run and is not the final public number. We'll send updated assets and context in ~2 hours and would appreciate an attribution update." Anita, ok to send?

anita_legal: Minor edit: change "pre-validation run" to "internal pre-validation run." Approved after edit.

nate_pr: Sent correction to reporter with the updated wording and asked them to append a clarification. Also messaged top syndication partners asking them to hold reposts until we issue corrected assets (ETA 2h).

pressops_bot: Action items (auto): [nate_pr  reporter correction], [social_ops  hold promotions], [emily_marketing  prepare corrected assets], [anita_legal  approve public statement]. Checkpoint in 2 hours.

carmen_ceo: Good. Once corrected, we'll send a short exec note to partners acknowledging the clarification and linking the corrected assets. Keep me updated.

emily_marketing: I'm regenerating the graphs with final numbers and updating captions. ETA ~90 minutes; will drop links here.

nate_pr: Reporter confirmed they've appended a correction line. I'll keep monitoring for downstream pickups. Maintain syndication hold until Emily posts the assets and we confirm distribution plan.

emily_marketing: Assets uploaded to the release bucket (private link posted). Final checklist: alt text, CSV removed for partner drop, tracking params added. Posting public variant in 10m after Nate gives green light.

nate_pr: Green light from media side; social ops you can resume scheduled posts. Thanks team — closing this thread once public copy live."
